meta.name: caveman-help
meta.description: Quick-reference card for all caveman modes, skills, and commands. One-shot display, not a persistent mode. Trigger: /caveman-help, "caveman help", "what caveman commands", "how do I use caveman".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 敲一行指令，立刻看到全部模式、技能与命令的速查卡
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你总记不住对话助手有哪些命令和技能可用
copy.tagline_en: Type one command to view a quick-reference card for all modes, skills, and commands.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often forget which commands and skills your assistant offers.

howto.what: 触发后,Claude 会以 caveman 风格显示一张速查卡,列出所有模式、技能和命令的触发词与效果;一次性显示,不切换模式、不写入文件,也不持久化任何状态。
howto.when: 当输入 /caveman-help,或说“caveman help”、“what caveman commands”等时触发;每次只显示一次,不会进入持续模式。

say.note: 立刻显示所有模式与命令的速查卡。
以 caveman 风格列出可用命令。
展示帮助卡,说明模式与退出方法。

howto.what_en: When invoked, Claude displays a one-shot quick-reference card in caveman style listing all modes, skills, and commands with their triggers and effects. It does not change mode, write flag files, or persist anything.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /caveman-help, "caveman help", "what caveman commands", etc. Displays once and does not enter a persistent mode.

say_en.note: Shows the quick-reference card for all modes and skills.
Lists available commands in caveman style.
Shows the card including modes and how to exit.
